mapper.sql: em.id, em.elder_id, e.name as elder_name, em.medicine_id, em.medicine_name, em.dosage, em.frequency, em.administration_time, em.start_date, em.end_date, em.prescribed_by, em.prescribed_by_name, em.status, em.create_time, em.update_time, em.remark
